purpose: Teach: 放浪/分断/改憲/直撃/哀れ/中高年/棄却/斬り

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、若手の放浪を防ぐキャリア相談を強化しろ
lines.en: I want us to strengthen our career counseling to keep our younger staff from drifting.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Each phrase lands with weight. No filler. Direct eye contact. The tone of someone used to being heard the first time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内の分断を解消する社員交流会を行います
lines.en: Understood. We'll organize internal staff exchanges to break down departmental silos.
lines.style: Attentive and measured. A slight nod embedded in the voice. Professional but not stiff—he's taking this in and responding with a plan, not just receiving orders.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、改憲に関する社外発信は控えろ
lines.en: And we're keeping quiet on external commentary about constitutional matters.
lines.style: Firm, definitive. A rule being laid down. No room for interpretation. The pause before the main verb carries the weight of 'this is non-negotiable.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。台風直撃時の業務継続計画を整えました
lines.en: Yes. We've already finalized our business continuity plan for typhoon impacts.
lines.style: Quick, efficient. A small note of preparation and competence in his voice. Not defensive—just factual, showing he's ahead of the curve on this one.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 哀れな広告で同情を引くな
lines.en: Don't use cheap emotional manipulation in our advertising.
lines.style: Sharp, cutting. A brief pause before the main point. The disdain sits just below the surface. This is a principle being restated, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。中高年向け商品の開発を進めております
lines.en: Understood. We're moving forward with product development targeting middle-aged consumers.
lines.style: Steady and responsive. Acknowledges the criticism without defensiveness. The shift to the next point is smooth—he's pivoting forward, not dwelling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、提案棄却の判断は社長決裁とする
lines.en: Any decision to reject a proposal goes through my approval.
lines.style: Absolute clarity. Each word distinct. A boundary being drawn. His authority is the point being made, stated plainly without aggression.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。職場での斬り合いのような対立を避けます
lines.en: Yes. We'll make sure workplace disagreements stay constructive—no unnecessary conflict.
lines.style: Closing note, slightly softer than the previous exchanges. An acknowledgment that this matters. Still professional, but there's a hint that he understands the human cost of the alternatives.
